meta.title: {name} in videos – see the tool at work
meta.description: Seven short films recorded straight from {name}, with the demo company: data entry, consistency checks, consolidation, charts, Excel, templates and the audit.

title: See {name} at work
lead: Seven short films, recorded straight from the tool with the demo company. They have no sound, and they are in English.
note: Nothing is staged: these are real screens, with made-up data.

clips.title: Enter a value, attach the evidence, validate
steps: A contributor signs in. They see only what is assigned to them.
The bar at the top shows what is validated, drafted, still to fill in.
They search for the indicator they have to fill in.
One click opens it: the definition, the unit, last year’s figure.
They enter this year’s figure, taken from the invoice.
They attach the invoice. The evidence stays with the figure.
They validate.
The figure is counted, with its evidence attached to it.

clips.title: Unusual values show up before the audit
steps: The tool compares every value with last year, and with your own rules.
Anything worth a look lands in one list.
One click: the alert says what the problem is, in one sentence.
The person who entered it explains why — or corrects the figure.
The explanation stays with the value, for the auditor.

clips.title: Totals climb every level of your organisation
steps: Each figure is entered once, by the site that knows it.
Consolidation adds them up along your own levels.
Open a total to see where it comes from.
Site by site — and what is still missing.

clips.title: Charts you put together yourself, without asking IT
steps: A view is a page of charts you put together yourself.
Totals, trends, completion — on the organisations you choose.
Narrow it down to one country, one plant, one year.
Everyone keeps their own views. Nothing to ask IT for.

clips.title: Fill it in Excel, import it back
steps: Not everyone works in the tool. Some people work in Excel.
Download the file to fill in: your KPIs, your organisations, last year’s figures.
It comes back filled in. You hand it to the tool.
Nothing is written yet: the tool checks every line first.
You see what will be created, changed or rejected.
Then you import. The values land as drafts, ready to validate.

clips.title: Install a whole framework from the library
steps: The library comes with the tool.
The Voluntary Standard, pay transparency, and the eleven revised ESRS.
Look at a template before you install it.
Its KPIs, their units, their formulas: all written out.
Install it. It becomes your framework: change whatever you like.

clips.title: The auditor reads everything, changes nothing
steps: The auditor signs in with a read-only account.
They open any value they want to check.
Who entered it, who validated it, and when.
The evidence is attached to the figure itself.
And the history keeps every change, with its author.

fullscreenHint: On a phone, tap the full-screen button to read the screen.
